summary: traceable-board captures a model settled over an extended design session with vrknetha (ticket=story 1:1, JIT per-task planning+grilling, deterministic enforcement gates A/B/C, split rule, upgrade+sanitise skills). The genuine spec-level gaps are resolved by decisions already made in that session; recorded here rather than re-asked.
gaps: The Behaviour section carries implementation detail (Gate A/B/C mechanics, specific forge commands, CI shape) where a spec should assert capability-level guarantees.
One spec backs six distinct stories (JIT planning, enforcement, board/UI, ad-hoc, upgrade skill, sanitise skill); the two skills are separable capabilities.
The spec asserts determinism as non-negotiable but does not itself prove each rule reduces to a deterministic gate — that proof is per-story.
contradictions: The JIT per-task planning story directly conflicts with active decision 0007 (immutable-upfront-decomposition).
resolutions: Kept as an epic DESIGN-spec by intent: it asserts the guarantees (a task is not implemented without a JIT grill; a PR cannot merge without a complete on-board ticket; a done story carries a durable PR link), and the mechanics illustrate — each story's PLAN owns the real implementation and its own plan-grill re-checks the how.

traceable-board is the EPIC; `roadmap derive` turns it into per-story items (the harness allows one spec to back many stories). The skills remain facets of the same 'complete, backtrackable, self-maintaining board' capability; splitting into sub-specs is a roadmap-structuring choice made at derive time, not a spec defect.
Each story's plan must show its rule as a concrete gate (script/recorder/CI) in its Verify Plan; the spec's determinism clause is the acceptance bar the per-story grills enforce.

The JIT-planning story (not built first) carries a decision record amending/superseding 0007 — deliberate, per vrknetha's correctness call. The enforcement-gates story built FIRST does not touch 0007, so the supersession is not a prerequisite for the first ship; the conflict is scheduled to its own story + decision, never a silent exception.
